# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

We want this project to be a welcoming and constructive place for everyone. Participants are expected to:

- Be respectful and assume good intent.
- Give and receive feedback about ideas and code, not people.
- Use inclusive language and welcome different experiences.
- Accept responsibility for mistakes and help repair their impact.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, trolling, and unwanted sexual attention are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the repository maintainers through a private GitHub report. Reports will be reviewed confidentially and handled fairly. Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, or restrict participation when necessary to protect the community.
